name: Chicken Fried Rice
instructions: Cook rice, stir-fry vegetables, add diced chicken, scramble egg, mix with soy sauce.

name: Tomato Rice Bowl
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic, add diced tomatoes, cook rice in tomato mixture.

name: Simple Chicken Salad
instructions: Grill chicken, chop vegetables, toss together with olive oil and lemon dressing.

name: Classic Plov
instructions: Fry onion and meat, add carrots, layer rice on top, steam until done.

name: Pasta Carbonara
instructions: Cook pasta, fry bacon, mix egg with parmesan, combine off heat.

name: Vegetable Stir Fry
instructions: Heat oil, stir-fry vegetables on high heat, add soy sauce and ginger.

name: Beef Burger
instructions: Form beef patties, grill, assemble with toppings in bun.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, grill, simmer in spiced tomato cream sauce.

name: Caesar Salad
instructions: Toss romaine with Caesar dressing, top with croutons and parmesan.

name: Shashlik (Grilled Kebab)
instructions: Marinate lamb cubes in onion-vinegar mix, thread on skewers, grill over charcoal.

name: Egg Omelette
instructions: Whisk eggs with milk, cook in buttered pan, fold with cheese.

name: Lagman Noodle Soup
instructions: Pull noodles, make beef and vegetable broth, serve noodles in hot soup.

name: Mushroom Risotto
instructions: Toast rice, add broth gradually while stirring, fold in mushrooms and parmesan.

name: Fish and Chips
instructions: Batter fish in flour-egg mix, deep fry with potato chips.

name: Tomato Soup
instructions: Roast tomatoes, blend with sautéed onion and garlic, add cream.

name: Grilled Chicken Breast
instructions: Marinate chicken in herbs and lemon, grill until golden.

name: Potato Mash
instructions: Boil potatoes, mash with butter and warm milk until smooth.

name: Thai Green Curry
instructions: Simmer chicken in coconut milk with curry paste, add vegetables, serve with rice.

name: Samsa (Meat Pastry)
instructions: Make layered dough, fill with spiced minced lamb and onion, bake in tandoor.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
instructions: Brown beef mince, simmer in tomato sauce with vegetables, serve over spaghetti.

name: Banana Smoothie
instructions: Blend banana, milk, honey and ice until smooth.

name: Greek Salad
instructions: Chop vegetables, top with feta and olives, drizzle olive oil.

name: Manti (Uzbek Dumplings)
instructions: Make dough, fill with seasoned beef and onion, steam in mantovarka.

name: Pancakes
instructions: Mix batter, cook on griddle until bubbles form, flip and serve with syrup.

name: Chicken Wrap
instructions: Grill chicken, slice, wrap in tortilla with fresh vegetables and mayo.

name: Onion Soup
instructions: Caramelize onions slowly, add broth, top with bread and melted cheese.

name: Seafood Paella
instructions: Toast rice in saffron oil, add seafood and broth, cook uncovered until rice absorbs liquid.

name: Garlic Bread
instructions: Mix butter with minced garlic and parsley, spread on bread, bake until crispy.

name: Beef Stew
instructions: Brown beef, add vegetables and broth, simmer for 2 hours until tender.

name: Avocado Toast
instructions: Toast bread, mash avocado with lemon and salt, spread on toast, top with egg.

name: Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Simmer chicken in broth, add vegetables and noodles, cook until tender.

name: Margherita Pizza
instructions: Make dough, spread tomato sauce, add mozzarella and basil, bake at high heat.

name: Lamb Kebab
instructions: Mix minced lamb with spices, form on skewers, grill, serve in bread with yogurt.

name: Fried Egg with Toast
instructions: Fry egg in butter, toast bread, serve together with salt and pepper.

name: Chocolate Milkshake
instructions: Blend milk, chocolate, ice cream until smooth and thick.

name: Potato Curry
instructions: Fry onion and spices, add potato and tomato, simmer until potatoes are soft.

name: Tom Yum Soup
instructions: Boil broth with lemongrass, add shrimp and mushrooms, finish with lime and chili.

name: Chicken Quesadilla
instructions: Fill tortilla with chicken, cheese, and peppers, cook on both sides until crispy.

name: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Sauté vegetables, add broth, simmer until all vegetables are tender.

name: Tuna Sandwich
instructions: Mix tuna with mayo, layer on bread with lettuce, tomato, and onion.

name: Beef Stir Fry
instructions: Slice beef thin, stir-fry with garlic and ginger, add broccoli and soy sauce.

name: Fruit Salad
instructions: Chop fruits, mix with honey and lemon juice, serve chilled.

name: Egg Fried Noodles
instructions: Cook noodles, stir-fry with scrambled egg, vegetables, and soy sauce.

name: Honey Garlic Chicken
instructions: Coat chicken in honey-garlic-soy glaze, bake until caramelized, serve with rice.

name: Cheese Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta, make cheese sauce with butter, milk, and garlic, combine.
